digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter — ACLI subprocess execution and REST summary recovery
propositions: One Cloud summary write invocation must launch exactly one ACLI subprocess process with proper process-group and child cleanup.

Summary recovery observation issues one primary-store REST request with one-attempt/no-sleep policy, distinct from the default three-attempt/2s-5s-backoff retry behavior preserved in all other callers.

Retry policy must thread through _rest_urlopen_with_retry → _direct_rest_get → get_issue_by_rest as optional pass-through arguments, with only summary-recovery selecting the one-attempt policy and all existing consumers (outbound_differ.py:132, apply_handlers.py:259, binding_store.py:108) omitting the argument to retain unchanged behavior.
Permanent failure classes (auth, TLS, permission, invalid request) must not trigger local retry; transient outcomes (network, 429, retryable 5xx) return metadata to shared budget.

Every terminal or cleanup-failure outcome emits exactly one completion log with only logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 code points; operation diagnostics hold at most eight entries with redacted messages.
Historical exit/stdout/stderr triples decode deterministically with loud failure on unknown shapes; timeout cleanup preserves POSIX process groups and non-POSIX child-process semantics.
